# raktim-mondol/co-scientist — source dossier

**Scope:** M5 source assessment. No upstream setup, agent workflow, dependency install, or inference was run.

## Pinned source and reuse boundary

- Upstream: [raktim-mondol/co-scientist](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist), pinned at [`10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45`](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/commit/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45). Its ignored, detached working copy at `references/work/raktim-mondol-co-scientist/` was confirmed clean and removed after assessment.
- The root [LICENSE](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/LICENSE) declares MIT and copyright 2025 Raktim Mondol. The tracked `x_code/` tree, however, is described by its own [README](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/x_code/README.md#L50-L75) as a fork of Anthropic Claude Code recovered from an exposed source map; its [license section](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/x_code/README.md#L356-L360) says the original belongs to Anthropic. The root MIT declaration does not establish permission to reuse that component. Exclude `x_code/` and CLI/TUI implementations derived from it from execution and reuse. Assess scientific techniques in the root `src/` tree as ideas; independently implement accepted changes to avoid uncertain code provenance. No upstream code has been copied.
- The checkout has 2,181 tracked files, including 1,931 under `x_code/`; there is no tracked submodule. The relevant scientific implementation is under `src/agents/`, `src/memory/`, `src/taskQueue/`, `src/tools/`, `src/prompts/`, and `src/tests/`.

## Architecture and inspected areas

- **Runtime and persistence:** The project is a Bun/TypeScript CLI. [Package scripts and dependencies](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/package.json) use Drizzle/SQLite, sqlite-vec, OpenAI's client, Parallel Web, MCP, PQueue, Zod, Ink, and Handlebars. Its [schema](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/db/schema.ts#L1-L190) persists sessions, hypotheses, reviews, matches, proximity edges, task records, claim citations, embeddings, and feedback. The [queue](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/taskQueue/queue.ts) executes through in-memory PQueue rather than a leased durable queue; task logging does not itself supply restart recovery. The local FastAPI/LangGraph/SQLite task architecture therefore remains the execution contract.
- **Scientific modules:** The root `src/agents/` tree has generation, literature research, reflection, ranking, judge debiasing, evolution, proximity, provenance, citation integrity, experiment design, meta-review, and report modules. `src/prompts/` contains corresponding YAML prompts, including staged reflection and debate comparison. The detailed mechanism map and local comparison below distinguish code paths from advertised features.
- **Operations and scope:** [Configuration](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/config.ts#L1-L55) requires a DeepSeek API key and defaults to a 500,000-token run budget; the [example environment](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/.env.example) also describes Parallel Web and optional Consensus/Scite credentials. Importing configuration may read ambient credentials, so assessment is static until a justified isolated test is defined. The [roadmap](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/docs/ROADMAP.md) explicitly labels diversity-aware generation, mid-run steering, contradiction-driven experiments, real model tiering, LLM-based feedback reward extraction, a judge ensemble, and cost-aware scheduling as unimplemented or unselected. These are not shipped evidence.

## Mechanism map and source-versus-local comparison

Only concrete shipped behavior can motivate a candidate. The [paper corpus](../../docs/CORPUS-EXTRACTION.md) states that Google's ranking agent uses an Elo-based tournament, initialized at 1200, with pairwise debates and new/near-rating pairing. That is a **Google-backed requirement**. The mechanisms below are **external techniques**; similarity of agent names does not establish Google fidelity.

### Ranking, scheduling, and proximity

- **Ratings:** The source implements Glicko-2 with rating deviation and volatility in [tournament.ts](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/models/tournament.ts#L169-L236), with [numeric tests](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/tests/core.test.ts#L88-L176). Local `engine/src/co_scientist/agents/ranking/ranking_elo.py` preserves the paper-backed Elo contract. Glicko-2 is a different rating model; a higher number or self-rating would not show scientific improvement.
- **Position bias:** The source [judges both orders](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/ranking.ts#L165-L212) on its simple-comparison path and tests the adjudication helper in [judgeDebias.test.ts](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/tests/judgeDebias.test.ts#L8-L49). Its deeper debate path runs once in random orientation. Local `ranking_debate.py` already alternates presentation across debate turns and matchups, requires opposite-order consensus after minimum depth, and has regression coverage in `engine/tests/test_ranking_debate_consensus.py`. The source's stronger-sounding debias label is therefore not a blanket guarantee across both paths.
- **Pair selection:** The source [prioritizes rating deviation divided by match count](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/ranking.ts#L309-L346), then considers a proximity neighbor and random choice among other high-priority candidates. Local `ranking_matchmaking.py` already weights recency, rank, coverage, Elo closeness and cluster similarity, with no-starvation and seeded-replay tests in `engine/tests/test_ranking_matchmaking.py`. Explicit rating deviation is novel relative to local Elo, but the source provides no isolated evidence that it improves useful ranking decisions.
- **Rating persistence:** The source [updates two hypothesis ratings in one SQLite transaction](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/memory/stores/hypothesisStore.ts#L113-L146), but [writes the match record later](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/ranking.ts#L105-L142), so the entire match is not atomic. Local `app/app/engine_tasks_ranking.py` applies a match wave's rating and audit changes to engine state, then `engine_tasks_support.py` checkpoints that state and enqueues its successor in one SQLite transaction guarded by expected sequence. Replay skips an already-committed wave; `app/tests/test_engine_tasks.py` and `test_task_worker_resume.py` cover progression and recovery. A crash before commit can repeat provider judgments, but cannot leave half a rating pair committed.
- **Generation-time diversity:** Contrary to its stale [roadmap entry](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/docs/ROADMAP.md#L20-L34), the source [embeds candidates and rejects near neighbors before save](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/generation.ts#L104-L147), with [behavior tests](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/tests/generation-diversity.test.ts#L87-L126). It also computes [post-hoc proximity edges](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/proximity.ts#L17-L109). Local `state_reducers.py::AppendHypotheses` drops exact-text duplicates before checkpoint, but review backlog and the initial claim gate normally precede the LLM proximity pass. Thus a semantic near-duplicate can consume review and evidence work. A pre-review approximation must prove that it does not discard distinct mechanisms; the source's embedding threshold alone cannot establish that.
- **Budgets and replay:** The source [scheduler](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/taskQueue/queue.ts#L127-L279) stops at a token budget and samples weighted agent tasks, but does not allocate from the remaining budget and uses an in-memory queue. Its [seeded global RNG](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/util/rng.ts#L1-L68) is tested, yet replay still depends on execution order. Local ranking has a run-level match budget, minimum pair coverage, and pairing-local deterministic seeds. Those local durability and budget properties must not be weakened by importing the source scheduler.

### Research, evidence, reflection, feedback, and experiment design

- **Research and failure handling:** [LiteratureResearchAgent](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/literatureResearch.ts#L72-L188) runs bounded search, planning and extraction rounds; failed extractions are skipped, and generation falls back to search snippets if it gathers no readable source. The [search tool](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/tools/search.ts#L170-L267) has provider fallbacks and an empty-search counter that eventually stops generation. [Deep-research tests](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/tests/deepResearch.test.ts#L137-L303) cover missing credentials, empty extraction and round limits, but not the circuit breaker or a real provider outage. Local `literature_review/search_retry.py` and `orchestration.py` retry and isolate branches; `app/app/research_provenance.py` persists retrieval calls and degraded outcomes. The source behavior is a failure-mode comparison, not proof that an additional halt improves local runs.
- **Evidence and provenance:** [EvidenceStore](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/memory/stores/evidenceStore.ts#L10-L97) persists source metadata. The [ProvenanceAgent](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/provenance.ts#L23-L136) extracts a few claims, checks each against one top search-result abstract, and stores support verdicts. No dedicated provenance-agent test was found. Local `app/app/claim_verifier.py` and research provenance records use claim-to-passage evidence and publication gates; a one-abstract verdict cannot replace those checks. The source [citation resolver](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/tools/citationResolver.ts#L316-L363) also recovers DOIs from publisher pages or Crossref search, with mocked resolver/failure tests in `src/tests/citationResolver.test.ts`; whether this fills a local metadata gap is a separate question.
- **Reflection:** The [reflection cascade](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/reflection.ts#L76-L195) runs initial and full reviews, provenance and citation checks, then deep verification, simulation and observation reviews. Only initial/full failure rejects; later judgments affect ratings. Its [simulation prompt](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/prompts/reflection/simulation_review.yaml#L1-L29) is a model thought experiment, not executed simulation. No test of the full reflection sequence was found. Local `engine/src/co_scientist/agents/reflection/` already has staged review, deep verification, observations and evidence gates. An extra call is useful only if it changes an observable scientific decision without material regression.
- **Empirical feedback:** The source [reward signal](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/rlef/reward-signal.ts#L16-L125) maps keyword sentiment plus optional 0–10 reviewer-like scores to a Glicko-2 update; [reward memory](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/rlef/reward-store.ts#L26-L129) recalls strong signals across sessions, and [prompt injection](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/rlef/prompt-injection.ts#L21-L60) feeds them to later agents. [RLEF tests](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/tests/rlef.test.ts#L117-L359) cover formulas, storage, retrieval and manual composition, not real-outcome validity or the excluded CLI submission path. Local reviewer/meta-review feedback is not a record of independently observed experimental outcomes. This is a distinct possible gap; keyword scoring and direct rating changes are not validated evidence handling.
- **Experiment design:** The [ExperimentDesignAgent](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/experimentDesign.ts#L18-L88) saves a detailed protocol for top ideas after supervisor plateau, using a [prompt](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/prompts/experiment_design/protocol.yaml#L31-L51) that requests steps, controls, outcomes, materials, timing and cost tier. No agent-specific behavior test was found. Local `engine/src/co_scientist/agents/generation/experiment_plan.py` already formats steps and Go/No-Go criteria, but has no separate post-run protocol builder. Any added detail would need source grounding, feasibility and safety validation before publication.
- **Reports:** The source [ReportAgent](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/report.ts#L28-L160) combines model prose with deterministic methods, ranking and protocol summaries plus a resolved bibliography. [Report tests](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/tests/report.test.ts#L46-L219) cover bibliography, rendering and persistence, not the full manuscript-generation path. Local `app/app/report/build.py` assembles evidence-grounded reports with safety and claim gates. Manuscript export is a format opportunity, not an observed correctness gain.

## M5 candidate register

All source mechanisms are **external techniques** unless the retained Google corpus independently establishes a requirement. "Reuse" below means independent implementation of an idea; no upstream code is copied, given the bundled code-provenance uncertainty. Covered/rejected decisions carry no new cost and are supported by the static source/local comparison above. No candidate is counted as adopted until its behavior is verified.

- **M5-01 — Glicko-2 rating — rejected with evidence.** Gap proposed: better ranking uncertainty; [source](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/models/tournament.ts#L169-L236) adds deviation and volatility, while local `ranking_elo.py` uses the **Google-backed** Elo system. Its numeric unit tests show formula implementation, not superiority on held-out scientific judgments. Direct replacement would break a documented fidelity invariant. Boundary: ranking concordance and engine workflow if independently revisited; current adoption cost zero. A separate uncertainty experiment would need declared external-outcome concordance, not a higher rating.
- **M5-02 — Position-bias adjudication — already covered.** Gap: argument order can sway an LLM judge. The source's [swapped simple comparison](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/ranking.ts#L165-L212) does not cover its single-orientation debate, whereas local `ranking_debate.py` alternates order across both debate turns and matches and requires opposite-order consensus. `engine/tests/test_ranking_debate_consensus.py` tests it. Boundary: ranking output; cost zero.
- **M5-03 — Deviation-led pairing — rejected as a source transplant.** Gap: under-tested hypotheses deserve matches. The [source heuristic](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/ranking.ts#L309-L346) requires its Glicko deviation and has no isolated utility test. Local `ranking_matchmaking.py` directly weights match coverage, recency, rank, Elo closeness and proximity, with no-starvation tests. No demonstrated useful gap warrants coupling local Elo to Glicko state. Boundary: ranking concordance; cost zero.
- **M5-04 — Atomic rating update — already covered.** Gap: a crash must not leave one side's rating advanced. The source [transaction](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/memory/stores/hypothesisStore.ts#L113-L146) updates two rows but persists the match separately. Local `engine_tasks_support.py` atomically checkpoints the whole match wave and successor enqueue; sequence checks make replay idempotent. `app/tests/test_engine_tasks.py` and `test_task_worker_resume.py` cover progression/recovery. Repeating an uncommitted provider judgment remains a separate cost concern, not evidence of partial rating state. Boundary: durable execution; cost zero.
- **M5-05 — Early semantic duplicate screen — rejected with evidence.** Gap: generated near-duplicates can consume review and claim-verification work before local proximity deduplication. The source [pre-save embedding check](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/generation.ts#L104-L147) is implemented and tested with one-hot identical/orthogonal vectors, not distinct scientific claims. Local `state_reducers.py` safely removes exact text duplicates; local token-Dice proximity scores have no causal-direction awareness. The frozen [six-pair panel](m5-05-similarity-panel.json) and offline [source-lock result](m5-05-similarity-results-3.8.1.json) show that the source's 0.92 cutoff would suppress both an intervention reversal (0.9867) and an outcome reversal (0.9928), while its non-exact same-mechanism paraphrase scores only 0.9556. Thus the proposed destructive gate fails the declared zero-false-discard non-regression criterion, and raising the threshold enough to keep these distinct ideas would miss the tested paraphrase. A newer runtime reproduces the same failure [here](m5-05-similarity-results-4.3.0.json). Reuse: none; do not transplant the threshold, add a new embedding dependency, or generalize token-Dice to suppress review. Boundary: generation-to-review and ranking inputs. Evaluation cost: local CPU and public model download only, no model API or paid service. This synthetic counterexample rejects this source technique; it does not measure prevalence in real runs or rule out a separately validated future method.
- **M5-06 — Empty-search circuit breaker — already covered.** Gap: repeated retrieval failures should not masquerade as evidence. The source [counter](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/tools/search.ts#L170-L223) can halt generation, but lacks a provider-outage test. Local `literature_review/search_retry.py` retries boundedly; `app/app/research_provenance.py` and degradation tests retain failed-call provenance for report and review. An unconditioned five-empty halt could conflate a narrow but valid query with an outage. Boundary: retrieval/tool and report provenance; cost zero.
- **M5-07 — One-abstract claim provenance — rejected as a replacement.** Gap: report claims need attributable evidence. The source [ProvenanceAgent](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/provenance.ts#L54-L136) judges against one top abstract; local `app/app/claim_verifier.py`, persisted claim-evidence edges and publication gates retain passage-level support and block unsafe/contradicted claims. No dedicated source provenance test establishes better correctness. Boundary: claim support and report publication; cost zero.
- **M5-08 — DOI recovery from publisher pages — rejected for this campaign.** Gap: a URL-only source lacks a canonical DOI. The [resolver](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/tools/citationResolver.ts#L316-L363) can derive one, but local `citation_resolver.py` validates the available DOI, PMID or URL and `report/markdown/bibliography.py` deduplicates through title fallback; URL-only references still publish with title and link. The source's extra network lookups have no observed citation-support or publication gap to fix and would require a real-connector, provenance and error evaluation. Boundary: citation metadata/retrieval and report publication; adoption cost zero.
- **M5-09 — Extra review stages — already covered in purpose; source pattern rejected.** Gap: weak assumptions and protocol failures need scrutiny. The [source reflection cascade](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/reflection.ts#L76-L195) adds mental simulation and observation calls, without a whole-cascade test or measured decision gain. Local `engine/src/co_scientist/agents/reflection/` and `app/app/report/markdown/hypothesis.py` already hold deep-verification probes, simulation failure points, observation review and Go/No-Go judgments. Copying extra calls would spend free-model capacity without an evidenced improvement. Boundary: reflection output and safety/evidence gates; cost zero.
- **M5-10 — Hypothesis-linked empirical outcomes — adopted.** Gap: scientists could not attach a measured experimental result to an owned hypothesis and keep it distinct from model review; local `app/app/runs_contrib.py` previously accepted judgments and generic run-level attachments only. The source [feedback store and recall](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/rlef/reward-store.ts#L26-L129) demonstrate a separate empirical-record concept, but its [keyword reward and direct rating update](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/rlef/reward-signal.ts#L16-L125) are not a trustworthy validity measure and were not reused. An independently implemented append-only, signed-owner-scoped outcome now records hypothesis ID, method/conditions, observation and units, controls, interpretation, same-run evidence references and server-derived author/time in the existing hypothesis/report flow and audit stream. Red-first API/ownership and browser tests verify immutable provenance after refresh/reopen, no Elo mutation, no automatic scientific conclusion or steering, safe errors and accessible interaction. Boundaries: owned API, append-only store/event replay, report and browser workflow. No model or paid service was needed. Cross-run prompt injection remains excluded; this adoption makes no scientific-quality claim.
- **M5-11 — Separate post-run protocol agent — rejected for this campaign.** Gap proposed: more actionable experiments. The source [protocol generator](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/experimentDesign.ts#L18-L88) adds operational fields but has no agent-specific test or evidence/safety gate. Local `experiment_plan.py` and `report/markdown/hypothesis.py` already publish steps, Go/No-Go criteria, simulation failure points, decisive steps and time-to-verdict. A second ungrounded model-generated protocol risks implying lab readiness without source or feasibility validation; an independently designed, verified protocol workflow is outside this source adoption. Boundary: scientific-quality/report if reconsidered; cost zero now.
- **M5-12 — Manuscript generator — rejected as a source transplant.** Gap proposed: publication-style export. The source [report](https://github.com/raktim-mondol/co-scientist/blob/10aa84a3c5a774c6fe5de050000c3f5e0996eb45/src/agents/report.ts#L28-L160) mixes model prose with deterministic sections; its tests do not run generation end-to-end. Local `app/app/report/build.py` already publishes gated, evidence-rich reports. A new manuscript format is not an observed scientific or reliability gap for the existing workbench and would require its own claim-support and citation evaluation. Boundary: report publication; cost zero.

## Evaluation and release evidence

M5-05 used the source's own local [Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model](https://huggingface.co/Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2) at pinned revision `751bff37182d3f1213fa05d7196b954e230abad9` (the public model card declares Apache-2.0). The [probe](m5-05-similarity-probe.mjs) ran under isolated `env -i` shells with no ambient credentials, on CPU/q8 with mean pooling and normalized vectors. An `npm install --ignore-scripts` installed the package in temporary `/tmp` directories; no upstream setup, agent workflow, source code, external inference API or paid service ran. The source lockfile pins Transformers.js 3.8.1; the first probe used 4.3.0, then the same frozen pairs were rerun under the exact locked 3.8.1 runtime. The maintained probe reproduced the 3.8.1 JSON byte-for-byte. Source code sets model revision `main`, so this assessment pins the resolved public revision rather than assuming a mutable branch is stable.

| Runtime | Same-mechanism paraphrase | Opposite intervention | Opposite outcome | Distinct pairs falsely discarded at 0.92 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Source-locked 3.8.1 | 0.9556 | 0.9867 | 0.9928 | 2/4 |
| 4.3.0 | 0.9612 | 0.9936 | 0.9978 | 2/4 |

The panel was frozen before either measurement; only its runtime metadata was clarified afterward. The primary opportunity was additional non-exact duplicate reviews avoided, with zero discarded distinct mechanisms as the non-regression gate. The source technique fails that gate in both offline runtimes, so no three-trial live scientific-quality comparison or product implementation is justified. Local `proximity_similarity.pair_similarity` scored the synthetic opposite-intervention pair 0.967, showing that reusing its lexical score as a pre-review rejection threshold would not solve the causal-direction problem. M5-05 made no product-code change. The checkout was a static reference, never a runtime dependency, and was removed after release.

### M5-10a owned outcome record

The **local design choice**, independently implemented from the source's separate-feedback concept, is an append-only `hypothesis_outcomes` table and owned POST/GET API. A scientist can attach method, conditions, observation, units, controls, interpretation and same-run evidence IDs to a hypothesis; author and timestamp come from the server. The record keeps immutable hypothesis title/statement and evidence identity metadata so a finalizer replay or legacy resume cannot erase its provenance when agent-derived rows are regenerated. It copies no evidence abstract or uploaded document text. The `scientist.outcome` audit event is inserted in the same transaction and contains only IDs, author and time. The legacy cleanup retains that original event and sequence. The record is deliberately separate from reviews, claim-support assessments, Elo and engine steering; it makes no scientific-validity claim.

The test boundary is the owned public API plus persisted replay. `app/tests/test_hypothesis_outcomes.py` first failed because the POST route did not exist, then exposed outcome deletion under both publication replay and legacy resume. After correction, the outcome, resume and scientist-drain targeted suites passed (15 tests); coordinator rerun of outcome and resume tests passed (11). Ruff, format, app mypy and diff checks passed. Cross-run evidence/hypothesis requests return 404, and reopened reads preserve two appended records without changing reviews, claim edges, messages or Elo. No model request or paid service was used. The production table has never existed, so the intended release adds it through the existing idempotent schema bootstrap. A consistent pre-release production backup, its hash and `PRAGMA quick_check` result are recorded in [m5-production-backup.json](m5-production-backup.json). At this API-only boundary, UI/report and deployed behavior remained open.

### M5-10b existing-view integration

The Ideas detail shows outcomes for its selected hypothesis and offers an accessible submission form on owned runs. Public demos show the records read-only because their owner is the demo principal. The Summary report displays post-publication scientist observations separately from generated conclusions, with the immutable hypothesis/evidence snapshots when live agent rows have been regenerated. The outcome GET has its own loading/error state, so its failure does not hide the generated report. The authenticated `scientist.outcome` event refetches that collection; a red-first deferred-response test led to a request-generation guard so older same-run responses cannot overwrite a newly saved outcome.

The browser boundary is `e2e/tests/09_empirical_outcomes.spec.ts`. On an owned completed offline run, the real API rejects invalid evidence IDs, keeps the form entry, then accepts a corrected submission; refresh, report navigation and reload show the persisted record. Keyboard tab order and loading state were observed. The demo case confirms the form is absent. Independent review found and closed the initial demo-write mismatch. The focused Chromium suite passed twice after a transient button-state assertion was replaced by durable HTTP/error checks; 46 focused Vitest tests, frontend lint and build passed. No provider inference was run. Final release checks and the production read boundary are recorded below.

### M5 local release verification

The product tree at `6490ef25` passed `make test-all` (3,144 engine tests with two existing skips; 1,888 app tests; 283 MCP tests; the 115-row parity ledger and evaluation tests), `make lint`, `make typecheck`, `make build`, `make eval-smoke`, the complete frontend suite (125 files, 750 tests), and `make e2e` (15 Chromium tests). The outcome-store helper split corrected the function-length gate's first failure; the composite run passed that gate without changing its ceiling. The outcome API, publication replay, legacy resume, ownership, report display and browser submission cases ran on that code. A later security review opened M5-10c below, so these are historical passing receipts rather than final release clearance. No execution-confinement or container behavior changed, so `make test-sandbox-linux` was not applicable.

Affected offline checks were run without provider credentials: `python -m evaluations.elo_concordance_eval` used its deterministic synthetic comparator (correctness-preferring mean Kendall tau-b 0.9129, top-1 accuracy 1.0, eight hand-authored items); `python -m evaluations.citation_eval` passed its deterministic 20-case panel (accuracy and contradiction recall 1.0); `python -m evaluations.retrieval_replay_eval` reproduced two synthetic retrieval calls with id reproduction, result-set completeness and evidence resolution all 1.0. The full engine suite includes scheduling-policy, matchmaking and Elo regression tests. These checks establish no new scientific-quality gain: M5-05's destructive filter failed its declared non-regression gate, and M5-10 records human observations without changing model judgments. The dated evaluator JSON outputs were temporary generated artifacts; the commands, fixed input names and results are retained here for reproduction.

Before deployment, the normal schema bootstrap was rehearsed twice in fresh processes against a secure copy of the consistent [pre-M5 production backup](m5-production-backup.json). `PRAGMA quick_check` returned `ok` before and after. The additive migration created `hypothesis_outcomes` with zero rows; all 31 preexisting application tables retained their row counts and sampled primary-key fingerprints, and the second bootstrap left the schema and data unchanged. The temporary copy and WAL sidecars were removed. The original production database was not touched by this rehearsal.

### M5-10c signed-session boundary

An independent pre-PR review found that compatibility callers can supply another run owner's `X-Client-ID`. The new observation endpoints initially inherited that app-wide scope, which would let a caller who knew both identifiers read or append private outcome text. A read-only Railway variable-name check on the production API confirmed `AUTH_MODE` is unset, so the code's compatibility default applies; `AUTH_SECRET` and `RESEARCHER_ACCESS_CODES` are configured. No variable values were exposed. The scoped correction requires an existing verified bearer session for private outcome reads and every outcome write while retaining public, read-only demo access. Switching global auth would disrupt other users, and accepting the inherited weakness would expose a newly added scientist record. Existing run endpoints outside this new feature are unchanged.

The red compatibility test reproduced private GET 200 and POST 201 with only a spoofed owner header. After the guard, the coordinator reran the outcome/auth API boundary: 22 tests passed, including unsigned GET/POST 401, signed-owner access, signed non-owner 404, public demo GET and denied demo write. Malformed or expired bearer tokens now return JSON 401 from the existing middleware instead of 500. Focused frontend tests passed 9/9. Two Chromium cases confirmed that an unsigned browser sees the researcher-access prompt instead of a submission form, sign-in uses a bearer session for owned GET/POST and survives refresh/report navigation, and demos remain publicly readable without a form. On committed product code `c49916be`, `make test-all` passed (3,144 engine tests with two existing skips; 1,892 app tests; 283 MCP tests; parity and evaluator tests). `make lint`, `make typecheck`, `make build`, `make eval-smoke`, and `make e2e` passed; the last exercised 15 Chromium cases. The complete frontend suite passed 125 files and 753 tests with `vitest run --maxWorkers=2`. Its first unbounded attempt exposed two existing private-report tests that lacked a signed session; the tests now establish that session without changing their outcome assertions. After this test-only change, lint and typecheck passed again. The unbounded runner also caused unrelated timing failures under excessive worker contention; the bounded clean run is the release receipt. No execution-confinement or container behavior changed, so the sandbox Linux check was inapplicable. Production observation is recorded below.

### M5 release and production verification

PR [#25](https://github.com/guy915/Co-Scientist/pull/25) merged the tested branch to `main` at `d86b16f37cf881956f0379979124c68bf2806846`. GitHub Actions stopped before executing any job steps under the account billing hold; hosted CI was explicitly waived by the user and is not claimed as passing. The local release checks above, including the 15-case browser suite, are the verification receipt.

Vercel production deployment `dpl_88fU3FyAn76bwTNhPpu8jhx82u6H` is READY at that commit, and `https://ai-co-scientist.com/` returned HTTP 200. Railway production API `0e84e72e-9a3c-42f4-858d-d9adf3db28fb` and MCP `1c47a4ae-989d-4a2c-afd5-e7368f5e9036` both reached SUCCESS at the same commit. The API service config has one replica in `sfo`, healthcheck `/health`, and the persistent volume mounted at `/app/data`; the expected database, cache, and run-UID variable names remain present. This read-only config check did not reveal their values. The existing `evaluations.prod_smoke` passed: health, MCP availability, notifications, real backend, ownership isolation, CORS, and sanitized sharing.

The [sanitized production probe](m5-production-verification.json) used an existing campaign-owned public-goal run and a verified researcher session. Signed run/hypothesis/outcome GETs returned 200; the cancelled run has zero hypotheses and outcomes. A spoofed `X-Client-ID` received 401 and an unauthenticated read received 404, so neither read private outcomes. The probe made zero model calls and no writes. A successful production outcome POST would require a real hypothesis and a truthful measured result; inventing either would pollute the append-only scientific record. Successful POST, persistence, and report display were instead verified through the isolated real-API Chromium flow and local tests. This production limitation is explicit rather than represented as a live empirical result.

A separate credential-free visual probe used the curated offline E2E run with browser-only outcome responses. Dark and light Ideas forms rendered at desktop (1440px) and mobile (390px) widths, and the saved observation appeared in Research Overview in both themes. The seven fields stayed enabled at 14px with measured input contrast at least 16.48:1; neither Ideas nor the report overflowed horizontally. The original theme-switch step timed out in the temporary probe, so the light theme was verified in a fresh browser context initialized with the app's `cosci-theme=light` preference. These stubs establish rendering and interaction only; the separate real-API E2E cases establish persistence and ownership. No production or provider calls were made for this probe.
